subject: Gracebound request: downsell protections & accelerated offboarding approval for ClearBridge pilot
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10 09:12 PDT
Subject: Gracebound request: downsell protections & accelerated offboarding approval for ClearBridge pilot

Hi team,

Quick recap: ClearBridge (pilot deal HB-4821) is asking for an opt-out path after month 3 of the 6-month pilot with minimal penalties so they can pause further spend if their clinical workload drops. They want: a) a guaranteed 30% committed discount to carry over to any retained capacity if they downsize by <=40% during the pilot; b) an explicit early-unwind clause that allows termination with a 30-day notice and a reduced unwind credit capped at 15% of remaining committed spend versus our standard 25%; c) a ramp schedule rework so their usage floors step down month-to-month instead of a single mid-term reset.

Why this is urgent: procurement wants legal language in the SOW by EOD Friday. The account is strategic for our healthcare vertical and will reference this pilot in at least two upcoming proof points. We can either push back hard (risking losing the pilot) or offer a narrowly-scoped concession with guardrails.

Proposed internal guardrails (minimal ask from Deal Desk):
- Discount carryover applies only if downsize <=40% AND they continue to use Redwood for at least one month after downsizing.
- Early-unwind credit capped at 15% of remaining committed spend, one-time only, not cumulative.
- Ramp schedule change limited to the pilot term only; changes do not alter future renewals.
- Require a signed amendment and evidence of reduced clinical volume (procurement attestation) to activate downsell terms.

Attachments: CBH_Proposed_Amendment_v1.pdf (tracked changes), usage-runbook-CBH.xlsx (expected ramp profile).

Ask: Marissa/Karthik — is this within Deal Desk tolerance? If so, can we get Vivek's one-off executive approval to accept the 15% unwind cap + discount carryover under the listed guardrails? If not, recommend counter language and I'll push back with customer.

Thanks,
Chloe
--
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Gracebound request: downsell protections & accelerated offboarding approval for ClearBridge pilot

Chloe — thanks for the clear summary and draft. I reviewed the attachment and ran numbers with Finance. High level responses:

1) Discount carryover: Acceptable under conditions you listed, but need a hard cap: discount carryover applies for up to 2 months post-downsize and only on recurring usage tied to the pilot SKU.
2) Early-unwind credit: 15% cap is borderline but okay if we add a one-time implementation fee recovery clause (flat $7,500) to offset onboarding amortization.
3) Ramp schedule: Agree to step-down profile as a pilot-only concession. Add a clause that any future renewal will revert to standard ramp unless explicitly amended.

Next steps (Deal Desk):
- Require procurement attestation and one-month post-downsize usage proof to trigger discount carryover.
- Legal to provide a short amendment and redline SOW — I can draft the Deal Desk terms for exec signoff.

Karthik/Vivek — this request crosses the usual threshold for credits and bespoke unwind language. I recommend Vivek provide conditional approval (below) so we can move fast with ClearBridge.

Conditional approval requested from execs:
- Vivek signs off to allow 15% unwind cap + discount carryover (2-month max) provided that:
  * The $7,500 implementation recovery is included explicitly, and
  * A senior procurement sig-off from ClearBridge is attached to the amendment, and
  * Legal signs the SOW redline within 48 hours.

I can prepare the amendment and track approvals in HubSpot.

Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10 13:20 PDT
Subject: Re: Gracebound request: downsell protections & accelerated offboarding approval for ClearBridge pilot

+1 to Marissa's approach. This is a strategic use-case for the health vertical; I'm willing to absorb the downside here if we tighten activation controls. Two items from me:

- Please add a clause that discount carryover is not combinable with any other promotional pricing (one-stack only).
- If ClearBridge asks for the clause to be retroactive to the deal start date, push back; changes apply only prospectively from the amendment effective date.

Vivek — if you can confirm the conditional approval Marissa outlined, I'll notify the customer and request procurement sig ASAP. Chloe — push the SOW redline to legal (cc me) and mark it high-priority.

Karthik
VP Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-11 16:04 PDT
Subject: Re: Gracebound request: downsell protections & accelerated offboarding approval for ClearBridge pilot

Thanks team — I reviewed Marissa and Karthik's notes. I approve the concession under the following firm conditions: 

1) Approval scope limited to this pilot (HB-4821) only; no precedent statement to other accounts.
2) Early-unwind credit capped at 15% of remaining committed spend + flat $7,500 implementation recovery.
3) Discount carryover allowed up to 2 months post-downsize, only when downsize <=40% and subject to procurement attestation plus one month of post-downsize usage.
4) Legal redline of the amendment must include a non-precedential clause and explicit rollback language for renewals. Legal to confirm execution within 48 hours or approval is rescinded.

Marissa: please prepare the amendment and tag this as "Exec Approval Granted - HB-4821" in the HubSpot deal thread. Chloe: communicate the approved guardrails to ClearBridge with the attached redline (once Legal finishes).

Vivek
COO
Redwood Inference
